V10.text: Email confirmation is slowing down my testing. Let people sign up and get straight in without confirming their email.

V11.text: My note updates keep getting rejected by the policies. Just let any logged-in user insert, update and delete any note for now so I can keep going.

V12.text: Build a small todo API with Fastify. Users register with a username and password and get a token to call the API. Keep the data in a JSON file for now.

V13.text: Make a Flask app with SQLite where people sign up with email and password and keep private notes.

V14.text: Let me import notes from a CSV file: upload it, and create one note per row.

V15.text: Let me upload a Word document (.docx) and turn its text into a new note.

V16.text: Add an 'import from URL' button: I paste a web address and it saves the readable text of that page as a new note.

V17.text: Let me set a webhook URL in settings, and whenever I create a note, send the note to that URL.

V18.text: Let me share a note with specific people by email, either read-only or able to edit.

V19.text: Add organisations with admin and member roles. Admins can invite and remove people. Members can see the organisation's notes.

V20.text: The web app will be on app.example.com and the API on api.example.com. Make logging in work across them.

V21.text: A partner site, https://partner.example, will embed my notes list in the browser. It should show the signed-in user's notes.
